value_label: blocks the kaspa network produces every single day
headline:
bitcoin finds *144 blocks*.
kaspa finds 864,000.

panes.title: BLOCKS IN TWENTY FOUR HOURS
panes.sub: protocol target, not an average of a good day

panes.title: WHY IT DOES NOT COLLAPSE
lines: parallel blocks are not thrown away. they are *ordered and kept*.

post.x: kaspa produces 864,000 blocks a day. bitcoin produces about 144. ten every second against one every ten minutes. blocks found at the same moment are not discarded, they are ordered and kept, and that is the part most comparisons leave out.
post.reply: how that ordering works is explained on kaspapulse.com. the coins per block shrink, the number of blocks does not.
